mostWorthwhile.text: The impact that formed the Moon was satisfying and informative: debris gathered into a companion that reflects sunlight.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making light by combining the Sun and rocky world felt less consequential than the other passages, since it left the night-light goal unresolved.

surprise.text: Air and the rocky world producing axial tilt surprised me; the follow-up explanation of seasons was useful, although the air-to-tilt connection remained unclear.

arbitrary.text: Using air to tilt the rocky world lacked a clear physical purpose to me, even though the resulting seasons explanation made sense.

continue.text: Yes. The Moon's impact origin and the explanation of seasons made me curious about what the world might make next, despite a few unclear combinations.
